evidence: Traupman 38, 391: dial a number, numerum (tēlephōnicum) sēligere
terms.comment: “Choose out the number”: sēligō, sēligere, sēlēgī, sēlēctum, to pick out, is classical (Cic. Or. 47); the telephone sense is Traupman’s. The area code is numerus praesēlēctōrius.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 38, 391, each phrase checked against the searchable text of the book.
